text: Pump P-101A must be inspected every 2000 operating hours [1], and its vibration must stay at or below 3.0 mm/s RMS at the bearing housing per API 610 [2].

sources.text: The centrifugal pump P-101A shall be inspected at intervals not exceeding 2000 operating hours.
Vibration limits per API 610 shall not exceed 3.0 mm/s RMS measured at the bearing housing.
